# s363 — TUI relay request: which marked statuses drop out

**Findings:** s353 relay 2026-10-17: `Q` silently drops marks on done and retired items; parked, handed-off and in-review marks stay; a done item selected with no marks is still requested · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-18** — Owner decision 2026-10-17: drop set stays done+retired; Q notifies naming dropped ids; unmarked selected done item follows the same rule.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:** persisting marks, or a mark column.

## Why

s353 made `Q` leave out marks on finished items (done, retired) and chose to drop them rather than flag them. Three questions are left:
- should parked, handed-off and in-review marks drop out too;
- should `Q` say which marks it dropped (a notify naming the ids);
- a done item selected with no marks is still requested, while the same item marked is left out.
Also: queue rows lose alignment past 999 rows (the number slot grows from 3 to 4 cells).
